name: Brushwork Studio
summary:
Relax and unwind as you create beautiful, realistic paintings in your own art studio. With easy to learn controls, you will be painting in no time. 

🖼 -REALISTIC PAINTING-
Mix and blend colors to get the exact color that you need. Brushes can even pick up more than one color at once.

🎨-CUSTOMIZE YOUR STUDIO-
Hang up your paintings, choose from more environments, and more… Want to paint outdoors? Brushwork Studio allows you to change the environment and set the right atmosphere.
